name: Dinner Set Gang
description: A gang of thieves notorious in the late 1960s and 1970s for burglarizing the homes of wealthy Americans while the victims were at home eating dinner. Based in the United States, the gang was led by brothers-in-law Peter Salerno and Dominick Latella. The FBI attributed several hundred thefts worth an estimated $75–150 million in jewels to the gang, targeting families including the DuPonts, Flaglers, Wallaces, and Pillsburys, as well as entertainer Liberace. The gang avoided confrontations at all costs, carried no weapons, and would abandon a job empty-handed rather than risk a conflict.
